_description: Perk catalog — each perk fits into one or more slots and applies stat deltas + optional gameplay effects. At runtime, an archetype's base stats are modified by each equipped perk's deltas.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.description: Increases range at the cost of handling.

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.description: Greatly increases range, reduces stability and handling.

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.description: Increases range and stability.

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.description: Increases range and stability.

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.description: Increases stability.

perks.name: Choke
perks.description: Shotgun: tightens pellet spread, reduces range slightly.

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.description: Greatly increases magazine size, reduces reload speed.

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.description: Faster reloads when the magazine is empty.

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.description: Slightly increases magazine size, faster reload.

perks.name: High-Caliber Rounds
perks.description: Increases damage at the cost of magazine size.

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.description: Increases magazine size.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills increase damage for a short duration. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.description: Reloading grants bonus damage based on number of rapid kills.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.description: Melee kills or weapon kills increase damage. Stacks 5x.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Deals bonus damage to bosses, vehicles, and guardians in super.

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.description: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.description: Precision kills greatly increase reload speed.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed. Stacks 5x.

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.description: Causing damage with this weapon increases its stability.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.description: First shot of an attack has improved range and accuracy.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.description: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increased ammo reserves. Faster reload, stow, and ready when crouched.

perks._comment: === ROCKET LAUNCHER PERKS (can fit in either trait slot) ===
perks.name: Tracking Module
perks.description: Rockets now track enemies, but travel slower and do less damage.

perks.name: Cluster Bomb
perks.description: Rockets spawn secondary bomblets on detonation.

perks.name: Lasting Impression
perks.description: Rockets attach to surface and explode after a delay with bonus damage.
